text_en: Then Deborah and Barak son of Abinoam sang on that day, saying:
text_cn: 那一天德波辣和阿彼诺罕的儿子巴辣克作歌说：

text_en: “When locks are long in Israel, when the people offer themselves willingly— bless the Lord !
text_cn: “为了以色列中间有指挥的元帅，为了百姓自愿从军，你们应祝颂上主！

text_en: “Hear, O kings; give ear, O princes; to the Lord I will sing, I will make melody to the Lord , the God of Israel.
text_cn: 诸民，请听！君王，请听！诸侯，侧耳！对上主，我要歌唱，要赞颂上主以色列的天主！

text_en: “ Lord , when you went out from Seir, when you marched from the region of Edom, the earth trembled, and the heavens poured, the clouds indeed poured water.
text_cn: 上主，当你由色依尔出征时，当你由厄东地前进时，天摇地动，密云滴雨。

text_en: The mountains quaked before the Lord , the One of Sinai, before the Lord , the God of Israel.
text_cn: 山岳摇摇欲坠，在上主前，在上主以色列的天主前。

text_en: “In the days of Shamgar son of Anath, in the days of Jael, caravans ceased and travelers kept to the byways.
text_cn: 阿纳特之子沙默加尔年间，在为奴的当时，商队敛迹，行人转向弯曲的陌径。

text_en: The peasantry prospered in Israel, they grew fat on plunder, because you arose, Deborah, arose as a mother in Israel.
text_cn: 威力在以色列消逝了，消逝了！直到我德波辣崛起，直到以色列的母亲兴起。

text_en: When new gods were chosen, then war was in the gates. Was shield or spear to be seen among forty thousand in Israel?
text_cn: 以色列选择了新神，战争即临门下。四万以色列人中，不见一面盾牌，一支长矛。

text_en: My heart goes out to the commanders of Israel who offered themselves willingly among the people. Bless the Lord .
text_cn: 我的心灵向往以色列的首领，向往百姓中自愿从军者。请你们祝颂上主！

text_en: “Tell of it, you who ride on white donkeys, you who sit on rich carpets and you who walk by the way.
text_cn: 骑白驴的，坐华毯的，和过路行人，你们都要歌唱，

text_en: To the sound of musicians at the watering places, there they repeat the triumphs of the Lord , the triumphs of his peasantry in Israel. “Then down to the gates marched the people of the Lord .
text_cn: 加入水泉间缭绕的歌声！那里正在歌颂上主的胜利，歌颂他统治以色列的胜利。上主的百姓，速下到城门口！

text_en: “Awake, awake, Deborah! Awake, awake, utter a song! Arise, Barak, lead away your captives, O son of Abinoam.
text_cn: 奋发啊！奋发，德波辣！奋发啊！奋发，请歌唱！奋勇，起来，巴辣克！阿彼诺罕的儿子！擒住你的俘虏！

text_en: Then down marched the remnant of the noble; the people of the Lord marched down for him against the mighty.
text_cn: 英雄的后裔，请出征！上主的百姓，请随勇士为我出征！

text_en: From Ephraim they set out into the valley, following you, Benjamin, with your kin; from Machir marched down the commanders, and from Zebulun those who bear the marshal’s staff;
text_cn: 厄弗辣因盘据在山谷中，本雅明随你加入了行列；领袖由玛基尔进军，手执权杖的由则步隆出发。

text_en: the chiefs of Issachar came with Deborah, and Issachar faithful to Barak; into the valley they rushed out at his heels. Among the clans of Reuben there were great searchings of heart.
text_cn: 依撒加尔的首领与德波辣和巴辣克相偕；巴辣克在山谷中率领自己的步兵袭敌。勒乌本境内，大有运筹帷幄之士！

text_en: Why did you tarry among the sheepfolds, to hear the piping for the flocks? Among the clans of Reuben there were great searchings of heart.
text_cn: 为什么你坐在羊圈内，静听牧童的笛声？勒乌本境内，都是犹豫满怀的人。

text_en: Gilead stayed beyond the Jordan; and Dan, why did he abide with the ships? Asher sat still at the coast of the sea, settling down by his landings.
text_cn: 基肋阿得在约但河东安居；丹人为什么寄居船上？阿协尔在海岸静坐，在港口悠闲；

text_en: Zebulun is a people that scorned death; Naphtali too, on the heights of the field.
text_cn: 则步隆是好冒死舍命的子民，纳斐塔里在高原上奋不顾身。

text_en: “The kings came, they fought; then fought the kings of Canaan, at Taanach, by the waters of Megiddo; they got no spoils of silver.
text_cn: 君王齐来战斗，客纳罕众王鏖(áo)战，在默基多水傍──塔纳客，未曾掠去一个银钱。

text_en: The stars fought from heaven, from their courses they fought against Sisera.
text_cn: 星辰由天上参战，自其轨道与息色辣交锋。

text_en: The torrent Kishon swept them away, the onrushing torrent, the torrent Kishon. March on, my soul, with might!
text_cn: 克雄河的急流将仇敌冲没。我的心灵，勇敢践踏吧！

text_en: “Then loud beat the horses’ hoofs with the galloping, galloping of his steeds.
text_cn: 勇士急奔飞腾，马蹄挞挞作响。

text_en: “Curse Meroz, says the angel of the Lord , curse bitterly its inhabitants, because they did not come to the help of the Lord , to the help of the Lord against the mighty.
text_cn: 诅咒默洛次，诅咒其中的居民，因他未率领勇士来协助上主！

text_en: “Most blessed of women be Jael, the wife of Heber the Kenite, of tent-dwelling women most blessed.
text_cn: 雅厄耳，在女子中是可赞美的！在居于帐棚的女子中是可赞美的！

text_en: He asked water and she gave him milk, she brought him curds in a lordly bowl.
text_cn: 他求水，她给了奶，以珍贵的杯盘呈上了乳酪。

text_en: She put her hand to the tent peg and her right hand to the workmen’s mallet; she struck Sisera a blow, she crushed his head, she shattered and pierced his temple.
text_cn: 她左手拿着橛子，右手拿着匠人的锤子，打击了息色辣，打穿了他的头颅，击穿了他的太阳穴。

text_en: He sank, he fell, he lay still at her feet; at her feet he sank, he fell; where he sank, there he fell dead.
text_cn: 在她脚前屈身仆倒，深深入睡，昏迷至死；在她脚前屈身仆倒，蜷伏在那里，僵卧在那里。

text_en: “Out of the window she peered, the mother of Sisera gazed through the lattice: ‘Why is his chariot so long in coming? Why tarry the hoofbeats of his chariots? ’
text_cn: 息色辣的母亲自窗口探望，在铁棂中长叹：战车为什么迟迟不来？车轮为什么缓缓而行？

text_en: Her wisest ladies make answer, indeed, she answers the question herself:
text_cn: 聪明的宫女作了回答，自己心中亦反复思想：

text_en: ‘Are they not finding and dividing the spoil? — A girl or two for every man; spoil of dyed stuffs for Sisera, spoil of dyed stuffs embroidered, two pieces of dyed work embroidered for my neck as spoil? ’
text_cn: 或者获得掠物而在分赃，每人分得一二少女；息色辣取得彩衣为掠物，为我的颈项，获得锦绣彩衣。

text_en: “So perish all your enemies, O Lord ! But may your friends be like the sun as it rises in its might. ” And the land had rest forty years.
text_cn: 上主！愿你的敌人如此灭亡，愿爱你的人像兴起的旭日。”境内于是平安了四十年。
